testcase.name: On [0, 1] the parameters are exactly the correctly rounded k/(n-1) (INCLUDE_END) and k/n (EXCLUDE_END)
Counts 0, 1 and 2: empty set; one sample at the start (representative value t0) for both policies; both ends
Uniform parameter samples of constant-speed curves are equally spaced in distance (circle chords equal to rounding)
Validation: null curve, policy or limits; non-finite or reversed range; range width overflow; negative count; count above maxSamples (before any evaluation)
Uniform parameter sampling evaluates point(t) exactly once per sample and never the derivatives
Exact endpoints and points: first parameter t0, last t1 (INCLUDE_END), every point equals curve.point(t) bit for bit; parameters non-decreasing; extrapolated and signed-zero ranges
